The deviation clears both establishment tests in POL-RD-01. The governing distance field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which records 8.8 km against a booked optimal of 6.2 km from the routing engine — an excess of 2.6 km, or 41.94% of optimal. Both the 0.8 km absolute test and the 20% relative test are passed, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The excess must be measured on the trace figure, not on trip_record.actual_distance_km, which POL-RD-01 marks as a rounded convenience copy that may not be cited for the threshold test.

Nothing about this trace needs corroboration, because it is not impaired. It carries 115 fixes across the full 19-minute trip at a 10-second cadence with 100% coverage, an expected interval of 10 seconds, an empty gaps list and a max_gap_sec of 0.0. None of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) conditions — a gap over 90 seconds, a straight-line jump over 500 m, or a sustained interval above 30 seconds — is met, so the deviation may be established on the gps_trace alone and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

The driver's own counterparty statement removes any doubt about the cause of the excess: he says he 'missed the exit' and 'looped back right away'. That is an admission, on the record, that the vehicle left the optimal corridor — and it sits alongside a trace showing the car never exceeding a minimum separation of 0.92 m from the booked line at booking, then running 8.8 km against a 6.2 km optimal. Where the trace is unimpaired the admission is not strictly needed, but it forecloses any suggestion that the excess is a measurement artefact.

Artifact EV-ADVIS-00510-01 is MISSING — it has no payload, its admissibility status is MISSING and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, with the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT recorded. ruling.explanation:
This ruling decides the SGD 25.80 contested on trip TRP-00510, and it is addressed to both of you.

WHAT HAPPENED. The booking was an upfront-quoted fare: fare_breakdown.fare_model is UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd of 15.80 (EV-FARE-00510). The driver missed an exit and looped back — his own statement concedes the missed exit, and that account is accepted. The platform's trace (EV-GPS-00510) measures 8.8 km against the 6.2 km routing-engine optimal, an excess of 2.6 km / 41.94%. That clears both establishment tests in POL-RD-01 (over 20% of optimal and over 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It falls short of the MATERIAL gate (over 50% or over 8.0 km), so the enhanced consequences POL-RD-01 reserves for material deviations do not arise. Both advocates' claims on this point are accepted, in the same terms.

WHY THE DEVIATION DOES NOT SET THE MONEY. On an upfront-quoted trip POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, and the detour therefore costs the rider nothing on those lines. That is the driver's point and it is correct; it is also the rider's own concession, and it is why the rider's pleaded request for the whole charge to be reversed fails as a matter of policy, not merely on the numbers.

THE FIGURES. POL-RD-11(a) refunds the amount by which the charged total exceeds the quoted fare plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. charged_total = SGD 25.80; quoted_fare_sgd = SGD 15.80; properly chargeable = SGD 0.00 (no ERP gantries on the trip, erp_lines and off-optimal totals all 0.00, no airport surcharge — this trip neither originates at Changi nor Seletar — and waiting_time_fee SGD 0.00). 25.80 − 15.80 − 0.00 = SGD 10.00, which is exactly what the platform's own derived pol_rd_11_remedy publishes. The rider is refunded SGD 10.00. The further SGD 15.80 the rider asks for is not a remedy the policy provides on an upfront-quoted fare, and the contested figure of SGD 25.80 overstates the maximum exposure by that margin.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-RD-04's compensation limb does not fire: the fare breakdown's charged distance (8.8 km) is not less than the trace distance (8.8 km), so there is no unbilled shortfall. The exoneration limbs of POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 are all unavailable — no advisory invokes POL-RD-03, the chat log is empty so no rider-requested detour exists, no pin was amended, and this was a RYDE_X solo trip rather than a pool — and, because POL-RD-11 governs, their exoneration would not change the money in any event.

NO ESCALATION. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (115 fixes, 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, empty gaps list, max_gap_sec 0.0), so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) does not fire, POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged and the deviation is established on the trace alone. The trip identifiers match across EV-TRIP-00510, EV-GPS-00510 and EV-FARE-00510, the timestamps run forward, and the refund is far below the POL-RD-10(6) ceiling. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00510-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is noted: no party asserted a traffic closure against it — the driver's account is a missed exit, not a road closure — so no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. That absent artifact carries no fact; its absence is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it.

NO REFERRAL FIRES. POL-RD-09(4) yields nothing because the ledger carries no gantry the trace never crossed and no surcharge wrongly applied; POL-RD-06(c) yields nothing because driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 250, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established on the only fields POL-RD-06 permits, and the deviation on this trip is not material in any event.

CONFIDENCE. The deciding figures — charged total, quoted fare and the pass-through lines — are carried by EV-FARE-00510, corroborated by EV-TRIP-00510 and EV-GPS-00510, all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0. Confidence is 0.95.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
